_comment: Curated kanji contrast groups (2–6 kanji each). Each group needs a stable "id" so adding kanji updates the same Anki note on re-import. Regenerate: python3 wk_decks.py --deck kanji-contrast

groups.title: Next vs Lack
groups.note: 次 stacks ice (冫) on lack; 欠 is the lack shape alone.

groups.title: Open vs related
groups.note: WK: kai = open (開) vs kan = related/connected (関).

groups.title: Sea vs every
groups.note: WK: kai = sea (海) vs mai = every (毎).

groups.title: Earth vs other
groups.note: 土 = dirt/earth; 他 = other (person イ + earth 也).

groups.title: What vs same
groups.note: WK: nan = what (何) vs dou = same (同).

groups.title: Stab, sky, sharpen
groups.note: 研 = sharpen/grind (appears in 研究 research).
